Posted the draft in #strategic-random, as a reply to your message.

It uses the 2026-08-03 Hartford incident from #inc-vtg-hartford:
- First report: 10:42 AM, gate kiosks offline, both lanes showing a white screen.
- Kiosk 1 back: 11:03 AM (Mateo confirmed trailer 8836 checked in).
- Both lanes confirmed working: 11:07 AM, per your 11:08 update.

I left out the status-page access issue except for the INC-4821 reference. The incident channel is not one you're in; I read it as the assistant account, and nothing from it that you couldn't see is in the draft.
